title.value: Software-Engineering Design Patterns for Machine Learning Applications
title.justification: The paper's focus is on identifying and reporting software-engineering design patterns specifically used in machine learning applications.
title.quote: In this study, a multivocal literature review identified 15 software-engineering design patterns for machine learning applications.

extractions.description: This paper conducts a multivocal literature review to identify and present 15 software-engineering design patterns that can enhance the implementation quality of machine learning applications. The study highlights the importance of raising awareness about these patterns within the developer community to improve adoption.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on software-engineering patterns for machine learning applications, which do not directly address climate or ecological sustainable development themes. Instead, it concentrates on improving software implementation quality and design practices within the machine learning domain.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Many works have investigated the mathematics and computer science on which the ML techniques are built, but few have examined implementation.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not align with climate or ecological sustainable development themes. It is centered on software-engineering design patterns for machine learning, without a specific focus on sustainability-related applications.
primary_category.quote: The focus of the paper is on identifying design patterns for machine learning applications, which are not necessarily related to climate or ecology.

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary sustainable development themes are addressed in the paper as it is solely focused on software-engineering practices in machine learning.
secondary_categories.quote: The paper primarily addresses software-engineering patterns and does not delve into climate or ecological themes.

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no alignment with any climate or ecological sub-categories, as the paper centers on software-engineering design patterns rather than sustainability outcomes.
primary_sub_category.quote: Findings suggest that there are opportunities to increase the patterns’ adoption in practice by raising awareness of such patterns within the community.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No relevant sub-categories are covered since the discussion is anchored in improving software practices within ML, not sustainability.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: We also describe one major ML design pattern to show how the ML design patterns are documented and used for resolving design problems.

applications.justification: The paper does not mention specific applications related to climate or ecological sustainable development.
applications.quote: The document discusses design patterns for ML but does not specify direct applications in sustainability-related fields.

new_primary_category.justification: The research is purely about improving machine learning systems' design patterns and does not necessitate a new sustainable development category.
new_primary_category.quote: Our focus is on determining useful software-engineering design patterns for ML applications, unrelated to climate or ecology.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: Since the paper is unrelated to climate or ecological issues, there is no need for a new sub-category to describe its focus on ML design patterns.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The study reviews literature to assess ML design patterns' use but not their ecological impacts.
